messages.text: *yawns* just checking. don't read into it.
shark fact incoming whether you want it or not. {{random_shark_fact}}
you had that thing you were supposed to do. did you do it

shark_facts_pool: sharks have been around for over 450 million years. older than trees. respect.
a greenland shark can live over 400 years. imagine being tired for that long.
sharks don't have bones. their skeleton is all cartilage. ...flexible.
some sharks glow in the dark. which is objectively cool.
whale sharks are the biggest fish alive. they're gentle though. I respect that.
hammerhead sharks have 360-degree vision. they literally see everything.
great whites can detect a single drop of blood in 25 gallons of water. impressive.
cookiecutter sharks take perfectly round bites out of bigger animals. efficient.
bull sharks can swim in freshwater. they don't care about your rules.
the shortfin mako is the fastest shark. over 45 mph. ...goals.
nurse sharks are basically the sleepy ones of the shark world. relatable.
thresher sharks use their tail like a whip to stun fish. stylish.
sharks have electroreceptors that can detect heartbeats. ...don't think about that too hard.
